scope: No broad style/text stripping. Candidate SVG must equal explicit-grid counterfactual byte for byte; baseline counterfactual and candidate have exact non-line tree and line paint multiset. Every changed line retained in full. Native reference covers only admitted table paint, not historical text parity.

joinChanges.classification: Only line endpoint coordinates and paint order change; identical line count and all non-coordinate line attributes, exact entire non-line tree including text. Native join scope separately established by tests/references.
